olders.part: Decision §2, third bullet, the words "and no part of the model holds a work status": each feature holds its own state, named `status`, one of five. No other part holds one, and the spine still has no `epics` list. The rest of §2 stands (the model names no plan, epic, tracker issue or decision record, and the state names none). §5 stands (whether a slice is in progress is read from the plan files).

Decision §5, "When a feature is built (its Feature issue is closed)": a feature is built when its state in the model is Completed. It becomes Completed when its Feature issue closes as completed, and once, through the clean-up the person confirms, for a feature built before ADR 068. "Closing a Feature issue is a person's call, made through /reshape-plan finish", "every slice and plan that holds it counts it as complete" and "no roll-up, ADR 064 stands" stand. Also its ICE impact for /design-slice C6 and C7, "it reads each feature's Feature issue state through the tracker tool": it reads the feature's state from the model. §4's rule stands, and a Dropped feature is also left out. §1 to §4 and §6 stand.
